key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E084
name: fill_table_with_stepped_values
description: Writes the high and low words of a running value into four table slots spaced eight bytes apart, adding a fixed step to the value on each iteration. After the fill it enters an endless loop and never returns.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E0D6
name: clear_longword_buffer
description: Sets 20000 consecutive 32-bit longwords in a fixed buffer to zero, advancing the pointer each step, then returns the incoming register value unchanged.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E0F2
name: clear_large_longword_buffer
description: Sets 43200 consecutive 32-bit longwords in a fixed buffer to zero, advancing the pointer each step, then returns the incoming register value unchanged.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E10E
name: copy_longword_buffer
description: Copies 43200 consecutive 32-bit longwords from one fixed buffer into a second fixed buffer, advancing both pointers each step, and returns the incoming register value unchanged.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E134
name: release_port_and_signal
description: Frees a memory block referenced by one field when it is set, marks the structure's status byte and signal fields as unused, removes the port from the system list and frees its signal bit.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E17C
name: allocate_message_port
description: Reserves a signal bit and allocates a memory block for a message port, filling in the owning task, port type, signal number and the supplied pointer. It adds the port to the system list when a name is given and otherwise sets up an empty message list; if memory is unavailable it frees the signal and returns zero.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E208
name: mark_block_unused_and_free
description: Marks a structure as unused by setting one byte and two longword fields to all-ones, then releases its memory through the exec memory free call.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:fog:0:E238
name: allocate_typed_record
description: Returns zero when the argument pointer is zero or memory allocation fails. Otherwise it allocates a record, stores a type code of 5, clears a flag byte, and saves the argument pointer and a 16-bit parameter into it.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/EndCLI:0:0136
name: copy_table_then_invoke
description: When the buffer pointer taken from the stack is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed table into that buffer. It then calls through a stored function pointer and returns.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:0:0000
name: parse_startup_arguments
description: Allocates a startup record and finds the task, then, when started from the command line, splits the argument string into words. Double quotes group words, and star sequences in quoted text map to newline and escape characters. It releases the record through library calls before returning.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:0:01A0
name: release_saved_task_state
description: Stores a new value in the current task's saved-state slot, then runs the cleanup recorded for the previous record: an indirect call when its first field is set, a library close step when its pointer is set, and a pair of library calls for the second flag group. It returns the stored value.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:2:0000
name: start_workbench_tool
description: Decodes an XOR-scrambled string table in place, allocates a block and runs a long sequence of library calls to prepare and launch the tool. The text references show error messages for a missing resident tag and a failed start, and a -debug argument selects a diagnostic path.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:2:022A
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated byte strings character by character. It returns zero when they match, minus one when the first sorts lower, and one when it sorts higher.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:2:0250
name: build_node_list_from_table
description: Walks a table of linked entries, allocating an eight-byte node for each and storing a value looked up through a library call in it. The nodes are chained together and the head is returned, stopping early when an allocation or lookup fails.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:4:0000
name: patch_release_version_text
description: Compares a text buffer with a fixed reference string character by character. When the buffer's character at offset 20 is a '2' and the text matches, it writes a period and four spaces into the five bytes after offset 17.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:4:0028
name: write_version_dot_padding
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into the five bytes starting at offset 17 of a buffer.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:4:0048
name: match_reference_prefix
description: Walks a fixed reference string alongside a buffer, advancing both while their characters agree, and stops at the end of the reference or at the first mismatch. It returns no value, only the advanced buffer position.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:4:0058
name: return_without_action
description: A four-instruction routine with no observable operation; it returns directly and is referenced by three other routines.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:9:0000
name: forward_args_with_stack_slot
description: Passes its two incoming parameters to another routine together with a pointer to a fixed stack slot, then returns.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:c/LoadWB:8:0000
name: measure_buffer_and_forward
description: Calls a library function through a stored pointer, then measures the length of a 140-byte stack buffer up to its null terminator by counting down from minus one. When the length is nonzero it passes the buffer and length to another routine.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:FOGE.EXE:0:0000
name: clear_slot_and_release
description: Calls an indirect routine and two other routines, clears a longword just before a pointer passed in an address register, and frees memory through the library's free call before returning a register pair.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:0000
name: return_failure_code
description: Library code that returns minus one unconditionally, signalling failure to its caller.

name: increment_count_clear_flag
description: Library code that increments a 16-bit counter at offset 32 of a structure and clears bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:00EA
name: decrement_count_and_cleanup
description: Library code that decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32. When the counter reaches zero and flag bit 3 is set, it calls a cleanup routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:0100
name: unlink_node_or_defer_release
description: Library code that, when the counter at offset 8 is zero, unlinks the structure from its neighbouring list entries, calls a library routine and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets flag bit 3 to defer the release and returns zero.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:013A
name: set_deferred_release_flag
description: Library code that sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 to mark a structure for deferred release, then returns zero.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:0148
name: open_library_store_base
description: Stores an argument and a library base into a structure, opens the dos library through a library call and records the returned base. A failed open raises the exec alert call; a successful open copies the stored values into two global slots.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:017C
name: copy_two_fields_to_globals
description: Copies two 32-bit fields from a structure addressed by a register into two global variables and returns.

name: forward_to_shared_routine
description: Makes one call to a shared routine with no arguments and then returns, touching no other registers or memory.

description: Calls a library routine to obtain a structure from a supplied pointer, then stores the second argument into that structure's field at offset 148.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:0:0280
name: acquire_then_release_on_failure
description: Calls a routine to obtain a value; if the value is nonzero, it calls a second routine with it. When that second call fails, the value is released through a further call and zero is returned, otherwise the value is returned.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0000
name: load_record_into_structure
description: Obtains a structure through a library call and, when a second call succeeds, copies a local record of eleven longwords and several scattered fields into it.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:004A
name: copy_frame_fields_into_structure
description: Copies ten longwords from a caller's frame into a structure at offset 96, writes several more fields from the same frame, and then processes a referenced pointer when that field is set.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:009C

description: Returns zero without doing anything else. Two other routines use it as a no-operation result.

name: build_record_from_structure
description: Builds a local icon record starting with a fixed signature word and a version word of one, copies ten longwords and several scattered fields from the structure into it, and passes it to another routine.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0124
name: load_icon_info_file
description: Builds the path of an icon file by appending the .info suffix and opens the file. It reads the icon header and checks its magic word and version, then loads the image data into the icon record when the header is valid.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0180
name: read_icon_header_fields
description: Checks the icon magic and version words, clears two record fields, then reads the icon's remaining header fields through library calls. It allocates extra data when a flag in the record is set.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:024A
name: read_icon_image_list
description: Reads two icon values from the file and then loads each optional sub-structure the record points to, allocating storage for every one that is present.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:033A
name: read_pointer_list_from_file
description: Reads a list of 32-bit values from the file into successive slots, reducing a remaining byte count by four until it reaches zero. It then reads an optional trailing entry when the record points to one.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:03EE
name: call_then_return_zero
description: Makes one library call and returns zero regardless of its outcome.

description: Does nothing and returns immediately; two other routines call it as an empty stub.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:03FE
name: build_icon_path_and_read
description: Allocates a 260-byte path buffer and reports an out-of-memory error when that fails. Otherwise it joins the source name with the icon suffix and reads the icon's data through a series of library calls.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:043E
name: write_icon_info_file
description: Writes the icon header and image data to its .info file through indirect library calls. Optional blocks are written only when their pointers are set, and a type check clears a saved field first.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:04F2
name: write_icon_tool_types
description: Writes the optional sub-records of an icon when they are present, then writes the tool-type string list. It measures each string's length and writes it through indirect library calls.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0584
name: measure_and_write_string_list
description: Measures each string in the record's tool-type list and writes it to the file, adding to a running size counter. It then writes an optional trailing block when one is set and completes the write sequence.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:05AC
name: write_string_pointer_list
description: Walks a pointer array, writing each referenced string to the file through indirect library calls and stopping at the terminating null pointer. It then writes an optional trailing block when one is set.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0656
name: release_list_nodes
description: Walks a list from its head, passing each node to a release routine until the end of the list is reached, and releases the final node it found.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0662
name: drain_and_release_list
description: Repeatedly takes the next entry from a list through a library call and releases it. It stops when the list is empty or returns to its head, and releases the last entry it took.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0692
name: release_field_entry
description: Passes the address of the structure's field at offset 140 to a release routine and returns.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:06A8
name: allocate_and_attach_record
description: Allocates a zeroed 168-byte record and initialises a list head inside it. It attaches the record through two library calls, freeing it and returning zero if either step fails, otherwise returning the record.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:06F6
name: pass_through_library_call
description: Makes a single call to another library routine and returns, with no other work.

description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

name: store_entry_in_array
description: Decrements the entry counter of an array header, growing the array through a library call when the counter is exhausted. It then stores two values in the next eight-byte slot and returns one, or zero if growing fails.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0744
name: append_entry_pair
description: Decrements the entry counter of an array header and stores two values in the next eight-byte slot, then returns one.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0768
name: allocate_and_link_entry
description: Allocates a zeroed 94-byte entry and links it into a list. It registers the entry through two library calls, releasing it and returning zero when registration fails, otherwise returning the entry.

name: pass_field_address_78
description: Passes its first argument and the address of the structure's field at offset 78 to another routine, then returns.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0818
name: lookup_tool_type_by_key
description: Checks each name in a null-terminated list against a key. It returns a pointer to the value after the equals sign of the first matching entry, or zero when none matches.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0836
name: match_entry_value_pointer
description: Scans a null-terminated pointer list for an entry whose name part matches the key up to the equals sign. It returns a pointer to the value after the sign, or zero when the list ends first.

key: fields of glory (1991)(microprose)(m3)(disk 1 of 2)[cr psg]/Fields of Glory (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr PSG].adf:libs/icon.library:3:0856
name: search_string_list_for_key
